LIVE / HOME INVEST

Try the full app

Explore the same screens you get after installation. Filter the portfolio by broker, compare positions and review performance and dividends in Reports.

The public demo uses a fictional portfolio and is read-only. You can start without an account or broker file.

Launch the live demo ↗
  1. Switch brokers or currencies on the dashboard.
  2. Open Stocks and inspect the price history of a position.
  3. Go to Reports and explore returns, fees and dividends.

The full app includes a read-only demo with 10 brokers, 150 stocks and 10 currencies. Open My account → Choose profile → Demo. Without an account, use the language dialog.
